leads.name: Cu Lao Cham east-slope banyan (Hon Lao)
leads.reason: VACNE heritage tree 2015, 'over 600 years', one trunk with six prop roots (Tuoi Tre 2015, culaochamtour.com). The 600-year figure is repeated without basis and Thanh Nien 2024 does not explicitly tie it to this tree. No coordinate or trail point found: needs a geotagged photo or the island's own tree list.

leads.name: Cu Lao Cham red wutong trio (Suoi Tinh, Bai Lang)
leads.reason: Three trees recognised by VACNE 2015, ages 155 to 250 (Tuoi Tre) or 200 to 300 (Thanh Nien 2024); sources disagree, no species name, red flowers July to August per culaochamtour.com. Three trees on a slope, no coordinate, no measurements.

leads.name: Ngu Hanh shrine banyan, former Thong Dang prison
leads.species: Small-leaved banyan (page says Ficus pillusa, doubtful)
leads.reason: Banyan enclosing a Ngu Hanh shrine, Khoi 4 Cam Pho, about 200 m west of the Da Ken tree (hoianheritage.net 2011, 2026 article); called a heritage tree there but no decision seen, no size, no age, no coordinate. Access to the former prison site not established. Lead for a second pass with a site visit.

leads.name: Hoi An old-town and pagoda trees of the 2014 protected list (Phuoc Lam, Chuc Thanh, Vien Giac, Hai Tang pagodas)
leads.species: various (da, sop, sanh, bo de, xa cu, muong hoa dao, me, thi)
leads.reason: Decision 2627/QD-UBND (14 Nov 2014) protects 46 trees but the individual list was not found online; the 2026 heritage article names only types and pagodas. Ask Hoi An Heritage Centre or find the decision text.

leads.name: Cam Thanh water-coconut / Cam Kim village trees
leads.reason: Searched only generically: no named individual tree found for Cam Kim or Cam Thanh in any source seen. Nothing to verify.
